details.description: HIT Anti-Mosquito Spray is a highly effective solution designed to protect against mosquitoes. Formulated to kill mosquitoes instantly, including those carrying dengue and malaria, this spray ensures a mosquito-free environment. Easy to use, it can be sprayed in dark corners, under furniture, and in other mosquito-prone areas. The spray's powerful action targets and eliminates mosquitoes, providing long-lasting protection. Ideal for use in homes, offices, and other indoor spaces, HIT Anti-Mosquito Spray offers peace of mind and a safe environment, making it an essential product for safeguarding against mosquito-borne diseases.

Protect your home and family from the dangers of disease-carrying mosquitoes with HIT Anti-Mosquito Spray. This powerful insect killer is formulated with advanced technology to deliver instant, effective results. Spray it in all the hidden corners of your home - under the bed, behind the curtains, in cupboards - to eliminate mosquitoes, flies, and other bothersome bugs on contact. With its fast-acting formula, you can say goodbye to the constant buzzing and enjoy a peaceful, pest-free environment. Backed by clinical studies, HIT is 65% more effective than 2-in-1 multi-insect killers specifically for mosquitoes. Trusted by families across the country, this black HIT spray provides reliable protection against the spread of deadly diseases like Dengue, Chikungunya, and Malaria. Embrace a healthier, happier home with the power of HIT Anti-Mosquito Spray.

Godrej Lal HIT is an effective cockroach killer spray that is enabled with a Deep Reach Nozzle, which will help reach even the hidden cockroaches conveniently and eliminate them before they escape. Lal HIT eliminates any cockroach in just 3 seconds. Spray Lal HIT once every week in the areas where cockroaches usually hide in your kitchen, like under your dustbin, inside the sink outlet, under the fridge, under the gas cylinder etc. Freedom from cockroaches with just one application.

Introducing HIT Spray Matic, the ultimate answer to your mosquito troubles. This innovative device combines the instant power of an aerosol with the long-lasting effects of a liquid vaporizer, providing unmatched mosquito control. It starts working just 30 seconds after being switched on, automatically spraying every 2 hours for a total of 6 hours. This consistent spraying schedule ensures 12 hours of uninterrupted mosquito protection, and the device conveniently reactivates 24 hours after the initial spray, maintaining a hassle-free daily cycle. HIT Spray Matic is the perfect blend of effectiveness and convenience, ensuring your home stays mosquito-free with minimal effort. Embrace the power of cutting-edge technology and enjoy superior mosquito control with HIT Spray Matic
Why choose HIT Spray Matic?:
Convenient and Reliable: Set it once and forget it, the device manages the rest.
Effective Mosquito Control: Keeps your home mosquito-free with minimal effort.
Innovative Technology: Leading-edge auto-spray system for optimal performance.
Product is ready to use household insecticide to control/repel mosquitoes (Culex quinquefasciatus, Aedes aegypti) and houseflies (Musca domestica).

Innovative gel formulation that attracts and kills cockroaches and their nest. Making it extremely effective for households with medium to high infestation with a long-lasting effect.
The odourless gel and kitchen-safe formulation make it even more convenient to use in any place, like cupboard door hinges, cracks and crevices, nooks and corners and even the kitchen area.
details.usageInstructions: Just apply 20-30 dots in various corners of your kitchen and leave.

details.description: Banish pesky cockroaches and ants for good with the powerful HIT Cockroach Chalk. This specially formulated insecticide chalk provides an effective, convenient solution to eliminate these stubborn household pests. Simply draw lines or circles with the chalk in areas where cockroaches and ants are known to frequent, such as along baseboards, behind appliances, and in cracks and crevices. The potent insecticide within the chalk will quickly kill any crawling insects that dare to cross the line, offering immediate relief from infestations. With two chalk sticks included, you'll have ample coverage to target multiple problem areas and keep your home free of these unwanted invaders. The HIT Cockroach Chalk is safe for use and highly effective, making it a must-have for maintaining a pest-free living space.
details.usageInstructions: Just draw a line with HIT Chalk.

details.description: Introducing Hit Pre-Mixed Cubes - Rats Kills, the ultimate solution for controlling mice and rats. Designed with a potent formula, these rat killer cubes contain an anti-coagulant rodenticide (Bromadiolone) that can eliminate rodents in a single feed. The dynamic ingredient causes internal bleeding, leading to a quick and effective kill. These convenient cubes are easy to place in areas where rodents are most active, such as kitchens, attics, and basements, ensuring a successful solution to your pest control needs. With a compact size and a formulation that reduces the chances of rodents spreading diseases or damaging your property, Hit Pre-Mixed Cubes - Rats Kills is the ideal choice for a clean and effective rodent elimination.

Protect your home and car from rats and rodents with HIT Rat Repellent Spray. Formulated with a unique blend of natural active ingredients, it provides safe and effective rodent control without trapping, poisoning, or killing. Ideal for use in both the home and the car.
details.usageInstructions:
Unlock the trigger pump.
Shake the can well before use.
Spray at night in and around rat entry areas in cars and homes daily for effective results.

details.description: HIT Rat and Mouse Glue Pad is an easily disposable trap and killer for catching rats. It has no smell and is non-poisonous. It has a superior non-stick design with strong glue-gum for maximum effectiveness. Simply open the pack and place it near entry-exit points where rats appear. Place more traps if the infestation is high. Release the rat by pouring vegetable oil. Dispose of the glue pad along with the rat, once the rat has got stuck to the glue. Keep the glue pad away from children and pets. Avoid exposure to sunlight or moisture. If glue is stuck somewhere, use kerosene or vegetable oil. The glue pad can be used at home and office spaces.
details.usageInstructions:
Open the glue board carefully. Place it near entry-exit points, where rats appear.
Dispose of the glue board along with the rat once the rat has got stuck to the glue.
Place more traps if the infestation is high.
Keep away from food items, children and pets. Avoid getting glue stuck to any object or surface. Avoid exposure to sunlight or moisture for desired results.
